derivedFrom.note: Every metric is measured from the canonical pages. Where a primitive had no canonical equivalent, primitives.mjs records what it was derived from.

menuOutline.from: Menu / Плеер and Bottom Sheet strokes on both pages. Light uses a navy border rather than the neutral `outline`, consistently across both nodes, so this is a real role and not a light-page slip.

buttonSecondaryContainer.from: PLAYER > Broadcast History Section > Button ('Показать ещё') fill, and the UI KIT component 'Component / Dark / Button / Secondary'.

buttonSecondaryLabel.from: 'Показать ещё' label. Dark equals `primary`, which is what the UI KIT Secondary component specifies.

buttonOutlineContainer.from: ABOUT US > Button ('Читать подробнее') fill, and 'Component / Dark / Button / Outline'.

buttonOutlineLabel.from: 'Читать подробнее' label. Dark equals `textPrimary`, per the UI KIT Outline component. See TYPOGRAPHY-AND-COLOUR-OUTLIERS.md - this is the role that raw-hex matching mistook for textHeading.

buttonOutlineBorder.from: Same two buttons. Identical to `outline`; kept named so Android can diverge later.

error.from: canonical/semantic-tokens.json, confidence WEAK. Dark comes from the 'Token / error' swatch in the dark UI KIT; light is proposed. No canonical screen shows an error state.

disabledContainer.from: canonical/semantic-tokens.json `disabled`, PROPOSED. No canonical screen has a disabled control.

disabledContent.from: canonical/semantic-tokens.json `textDisabled`, WEAK. One dark-only node, light proposed.

scrim.from: canonical/semantic-tokens.json `scrim`, PROPOSED. Canonical sheets are drawn without a scrim.

navActiveContainer.from: BottomNavBar active pill, same hex on both pages.

navActiveContent.from: BottomNavBar active icon and label, same hex on both pages.

logo/apple-music.note: No Apple Music mark exists anywhere in the Figma file. Not drawn, not downloaded. The owner needs to place the mark in the file and put its node ids here.

logo/lastfm.note: No Last.fm mark exists anywhere in the Figma file. Not drawn, not downloaded. Needed by the Settings row and the Last.fm screen.

control/find-track.source: COLLECTION > Main > Collection List > Track Item 1 > Container > Button
control/find-track.note: The canonical per-track 'find track' control: 40x40, 1px primary stroke, radius 9999, primary glyph inside. Reused verbatim by Broadcast History so there is one action pattern, not two.

avatar/m3-01.note: Predefined profile avatars, expanded to avatar/m3-01 … avatar/m3-16. The intent is the official Material 3 Design Kit avatar assets. The plugin cannot pull them from a library it has not been given ids for, so every cell is created as an editable named slot. The dry run also lists any local components in this file whose name looks like an avatar, so their ids can be pasted in without hunting.

screens.title: Таймер сна · выбор
screens.notes: No option is preselected. A preset starts the timer and closes the sheet; 'Своё время' opens the picker instead.

screens.title: Таймер сна · своё время
screens.notes: Hours and minutes, so durations past an hour are expressible. The preview line resolves the duration to a wall-clock time before anything is committed.

screens.title: Таймер сна · своё время, ошибка
screens.notes: 0 ч 0 мин is the only invalid input. Установить is disabled rather than accepting it and failing later, and minus is disabled at zero.

screens.title: Таймер сна · активен
screens.notes: Reopening the sheet while a timer runs shows this state. The remaining time is computed from the stored absolute end time, never from a counter that restarts.

screens.title: Таймер сна · активен, своё время
screens.notes: A confirmed custom duration behaves exactly like a preset: absolute end time persisted, remaining time shown, cancellable, survives backgrounding and process recreation, and does not resume after a reboot.

nodes.n: Bottom Sheet / Таймер сна активен (своё время)

screens.title: Меню плеера · таймер активен
screens.notes: The canonical menu is 206 wide, which cannot hold a label plus a trailing value. Widened to 260. This is the only change proposed to the existing menu - both rows stay.

screens.title: Таймер сна · отменён
screens.notes: Composited over the Player, 16px from the sides, above the mini player. Not a screen.

screens.title: Таймер сна · сработал
screens.notes: Shown once when the timer fires and playback stops. 'Продолжить' resumes; nothing resumes on its own, and nothing resumes after a reboot.

screens.title: Сообщить о проблеме · пустая форма
screens.notes: Nothing is preselected and Send is disabled until a category is chosen.

screens.title: Сообщить о проблеме · заполнено
screens.notes: A category is chosen and the description is optional.

text.s: Играло минут двадцать, потом звук пропал,

screens.title: Сообщить о проблеме · отправка
screens.notes: The form stays visible and editable-looking but the button is inert.

text.s: Играло минут двадцать, потом звук пропал,

screens.title: Сообщить о проблеме · ошибка
screens.notes: The chosen category and the typed description are preserved. Nothing is cleared on failure.

text.s: Играло минут двадцать, потом звук пропал,

screens.title: Сообщить о проблеме · отправлено
screens.notes: The app posts to our own endpoint. The Telegram bot token lives on that endpoint and never ships in the APK.

screens.title: История эфира · список
screens.notes: Rows are variable height and never truncate. Two of the eight here wrap to a second line on purpose so the behaviour is reviewable. The time sits on the title's first line rather than drifting to the middle of a tall row. One trailing action, the canonical Collection control - there is no History-specific find icon.

ch.n: History Item / Краснознамённая дивизия имени моей бабушки
History Item / Прогулка по воде под дождём в конце ноября

text.s: Прогулка по воде под дождём в конце ноября

screens.title: История эфира · загрузка
screens.notes: Every horizontal anchor matches the loaded row: time at 13, art at 60, text at 116, action at 305. Placeholders for all four, including the trailing action, so nothing appears or shifts sideways when the data lands.

screens.title: История эфира · пусто
screens.notes: Shown when the endpoint answers with an empty list - distinct from the error state below.

screens.title: Найти трек · общий шит
screens.notes: One find-track pattern shared by Broadcast History, the player menu and Collection. Collection adds a divider and a destructive row below these four; nothing else differs.

screens.title: История эфира · ошибка
screens.notes: Shown on a network or HTTP failure. Retry re-requests; it does not clear a cached list.

screens.title: Коллекция · действия с треком
screens.notes: Replaces the per-track inline button. Four services, a divider, then the destructive action last and separated - the same shape as the canonical 'Найти трек' sheet it extends.

screens.title: Коллекция · меню экспорта
screens.notes: Opens from the TopAppBar overflow. Replaces the permanent 'Экспортировать список' button in the header, which costs 88px of vertical space on every visit for an action used rarely.

screens.title: Вход
screens.notes: Revised from PR #23: same flow, canonical colours and type. Sign-in is optional everywhere - the app must stay fully usable without an account.

screens.title: Создание аккаунта
screens.notes: Focused field uses a 2px primary border - the only focus treatment in the system, since no canonical screen shows one.

screens.title: Профиль · гость
screens.notes: Guest is a first-class state, not a degraded one. Registration is optional and there is no wall anywhere: the card states what already works without an account, and the list below is what an account adds rather than what it unlocks.

text.s: Радио, плеер, история эфира, таймер сна

screens.title: Профиль · вошли
screens.notes: Sign-out is destructive-styled but does not delete the local collection - that is stated in the confirm dialog, not here.

screens.title: Выбор аватара
screens.notes: Sixteen predefined avatars. No photo upload in 3.6.6. Every cell is an asset slot - Material 3 avatar nodes are referenced if they exist in the file, and left as empty named slots for the owner to fill if not. Nothing here is a drawn approximation.

screens.title: Настройки
screens.notes: Revised from PR #23: the same groups, but Sleep Timer is surfaced here as well as in the player menu, because a timer you can only reach mid-playback is hard to find.

screens.title: Настройки · тема
screens.notes: Three options only. PR #23 proposed a separate AMOLED variant; dropped, because the canonical dark background is #0f253e and a true-black variant would be a second dark theme to maintain.

screens.title: Настройки · синхронизация
screens.notes: The three rows under 'Состояния' are the alternate states of the card above, drawn inline so all four can be reviewed on one frame. In the app only one is visible at a time.

screens.title: Настройки · Last.fm
screens.notes: Both connection states on one frame for review. Authorisation goes through Last.fm's own web flow, so no credentials are entered in the app.
